title: Comprehensive RNA-Seq Dataset for Pan-Cancer Tumor Classification [pediatric meningioma subset]

publications.title: M&M: an RNA-seq based pan-cancer classifier for paediatric tumours.

institution: Princess Máxima Center for Pediatric Oncology, Utrecht
platform: KAPA RNA HyperPrep with RiboErase, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (2x150bp)
pipeline: STAR-Fusion 2.7.0f, GATK 4.0 best-practices workflow, TPM normalization
age_distribution: n=7, all labeled 'Pediatric' in the per-sample developmental-stage field; exact ages not given
processed_data_format: Gene-by-sample TPM count matrices (ArrayExpress_GenesvsSamples_Reference_06062024.csv, ArrayExpress_GenesvsSamples_Test_07112024.csv), covering all 1727 samples in the full deposit including these 7
needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-16), closing out a coverage_gaps.md-carried lead: 'E-MTAB-14038 ... Confirmed meningioma subset exists ... Not yet extracted into /data/: would require pulling the study's per-sample metadata/expression-matrix file to identify the specific 7 sample IDs (BioStudies API only exposes the factor-level count, not a per-sample GSM-style listing)'. Resolved this session by downloading the study's actual SDRF file directly (E-MTAB-14038.sdrf.txt, via https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/E-MTAB-14038/E-MTAB-14038.sdrf.txt -- not exposed through the BioStudies REST API's JSON response, which only surfaces the aggregate 'disease' factor-count table) rather than relying on the API alone. Parsed all 1727 rows directly: exactly 7 carry Characteristics[disease]='Meningioma', confirming the previously-uncertain count. Sample (Source Name) IDs: M067AAD_T1, M253AAE_T1, M275AAD_T1, M463AAE_T1, M530AAA_T1, M647AAD_T1, M841AAB_T1 -- all Characteristics[developmental stage]='Pediatric', Characteristics[organism part]='Tissue', library_strategy=RNA-Seq/paired-end. This is a genuinely rare pediatric meningioma transcriptomic cohort; every other meningioma record in this inventory is adult-predominant. The per-sample 'Description' field splits 5 as 'Classifier_reference' and 2 as 'Classifier_test' -- a machine-learning discovery/validation split for the paper's own pan-cancer classifier, not a clinical treatment_timepoint_status category, so deliberately not forced into that controlled-vocab field. No linked publication existed in the raw IDF file (submitter-only deposit, Princess Máxima Center for Pediatric Oncology); found via a targeted PubMed author search on the submitter (Baker-Hernandez JL): 'M&M: an RNA-seq based pan-cancer classifier for paediatric tumours' (EBioMedicine 2025, PMID 39709770), confirmed via its own open-access PMC full text (PMC11784659) to explicitly cite E-MTAB-14038 in its data availability statement (1 occurrence, verified via direct text search), and its stated purpose (an RNA-seq pan-cancer classifier for pediatric tumors, with a reference/test cohort split) matches this deposit's own IDF description and per-sample 'Classifier_reference'/'Classifier_test' labels exactly. Corresponding authors (Patrick Kemmeren, Lennart A Kester) confirmed via the PMC full text's author-notes contrib-group correspondence-footnote xrefs, not assumed from author-list position. No retraction/correction signal found. No per-sample grade/sex/brain-invasion/outcome data exists in the SDRF, so those fields correctly remain 'Not reported'. raw_data_available set false: only the processed gene-by-sample TPM matrices (covering the full 1727-sample deposit, not split per meningioma sample) are listed as Assays-and-Data files; no per-sample FASTQ/BAM files are exposed in the study's file listing.
